title: "heatmap"
output: pdf_document
date: "2025-11-11"
---

```{r}
library(readxl)
library(dplyr)
library(tidyr)
library(pheatmap)

#load
df <- read_excel("CLEANING DATA DRUG.xlsx",
                 sheet = "DATA_RECODED_DRUGS_BINARY")

#drug
legal_drugs   <- c("Caffeine_Use", "Nicotine_Use", "Alcohol_Use", "Chocolate_Use")
illegal_drugs <- c("Cocaine_Use", "Ketamine_Use", "Heroin_Use", "LSD_Use")
all_drugs     <- c(legal_drugs, illegal_drugs)

#education and age
df_small <- df %>%
  select(Age_Group, Education_Level_Final, all_of(all_drugs))

# make user status binary
df_num <- df_small %>%
  mutate(across(all_drugs, ~ ifelse(. == "User", 1, 0)))

# group age and ed
df_counts <- df_num %>%
  group_by(Age_Group, Education_Level_Final) %>%
  summarise(across(all_drugs, sum), .groups = "drop")

# prep for heatmap
heat_df <- df_counts %>%
  unite("AgeEdu", Age_Group, Education_Level_Final, sep = " | ") %>%
  pivot_longer(cols = all_drugs, names_to = "Drug", values_to = "Users") %>%
  mutate(Drug = gsub("_Use", "", Drug)) %>%   # ✅ now Drug exists, so this works
  pivot_wider(names_from = Drug, values_from = Users)

# make matrix
mat <- as.matrix(heat_df[ , -1])
rownames(mat) <- heat_df$AgeEdu

#make heatmap
pheatmap(mat,
         main = "Drug Use by Age + Education",
         cluster_rows = FALSE,
         cluster_cols = FALSE,
         color = colorRampPalette(c("white", "pink"))(50))


```
